track.name: Arts & humanities Python
track.item_order_rule: Each phase has four lessons in order and no checkpoint yet (restructured from the V1 general lessons).

items.title: Theatre board
items.intro: Say hello: Show messages and store numbers.

notebook.label: Make the theatre board say hello
What does the theatre board sho…
Build the line that shows: Curt…
Tap the line with the mistake.

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Make the theatre board say hello
questions.explanation_after_check: Words go inside quote marks. Then print shows them on the theatre board.
questions.hint_before_check: print() shows whatever is inside the brackets.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What does the theatre board show?
questions.explanation_after_check: print shows the words between the quote marks. The quote marks themselves are not shown.

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Build the line that shows: Curtain up!
questions.explanation_after_check: Start with print, then brackets, and put the words inside quote marks.

questions.label: Fix
questions.ask: Tap the line with the mistake.
questions.explanation_after_check: Words need quote marks. Fix: print("Bravo!")

c.feedback: That leaves the mistake in place.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows, in order?
questions.explanation_after_check: The computer runs the lines from top to bottom, so the first message shows first.

items.title: Counting chapters
items.intro: Say hello: Show messages and store numbers.

notebook.label: Build a line that shows 2 times…

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: Without quote marks, Python does the maths: 4 + 3 = 7.
questions.hint_before_check: Without quote marks, Python does the maths.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: True or false: this shows 4 + 3.
questions.explanation_after_check: Quote marks make it a message. The words show, and no adding happens.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: There are 4 chapters, then 3 more come. Which line shows 7?
questions.explanation_after_check: Leave off the quote marks so Python adds: 4 + 3 = 7.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Build a line that shows 2 times 8
questions.explanation_after_check: Python uses * for times. 2 * 8 = 16.

items.title: Labelled notebooks
items.intro: Say hello: Show messages and store numbers.

notebook.label: Put 3 pages in the notebook lab…
Which line does this: show what…

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Put 3 pages in the notebook labelled pages
questions.explanation_after_check: One = puts a value into the box. Two == would ask a question instead.
questions.hint_before_check: A variable is a labelled box that holds a value.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: pages holds 3, so print(pages) shows 3.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: The newest value replaces the old one. The box now holds 7.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: True or false: this shows 4.
questions.explanation_after_check: Quote marks make verses a word, so the word shows and not what the box holds.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: Which line does this: show what the box holds?
questions.explanation_after_check: = stores a value. print(name) shows the value. Quote marks show the name itself.

items.title: Writing day
items.intro: Say hello: Show messages and store numbers.

Tap the line with the mistake.
Which line does this: take away…

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: You write 10 more pages. Which line updates pages?
questions.explanation_after_check: Take the old value, add 10, and put it back in the same box.
questions.hint_before_check: Take the old value, change it, and put it back in the same box.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: You cut 2 pages. Build the line.
questions.explanation_after_check: Take the old value, subtract 2, and put it back in the box.

questions.label: Fix
questions.ask: Tap the line with the mistake.

b.feedback: That leaves the mistake in place.

questions.label: Predict

questions.explanation_after_check: + adds, - takes away, and * multiplies. The new value goes back in the box.

phases.title: Loops: repeat a step
phases.coding_idea: Repeat a scene chapter after chapter

items.title: Chapters pass
items.intro: Loops: repeat a step: Repeat a scene chapter after chapter.

notebook.label: How many times does Read show?
The choir sings the chorus 4 ti…
Build the first line of a loop…
True or false: this shows Clap,…

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: How many times does Read show?
questions.explanation_after_check: The indented line runs once each time round. range(3) means 3 times.
questions.hint_before_check: The indented line repeats each time round.

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: The choir sings the chorus 4 times. Fill the blank.
questions.explanation_after_check: range(4) repeats 4 times.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows, in order?
questions.explanation_after_check: Only the indented line repeats. The last line runs once, after the loop.

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Build the first line of a loop that runs 5 times
questions.explanation_after_check: A loop starts with for, a name, in, range(5) and a colon.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: True or false: this shows Clap, Clap, Clap, Done.
questions.explanation_after_check: Only the indented line repeats. Clap shows 3 times, then Done shows once.

items.title: Watch it grow
items.intro: Loops: repeat a step: Repeat a scene chapter after chapter.

notebook.label: A story gains 1 page every chap…
You have 9 pages left to read a…
The story should gain 2 pages e…

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: A story gains 1 page every chapter, starting at 1 page. How long is it at the end?
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round adds 1: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5.
questions.hint_before_check: Follow the loop one round at a time.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: You have 9 pages left to read and read 2 every chapter. How many are left?
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round takes away 2: 9 → 7 → 5 → 3.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: A rumour doubles its listeners every chapter. What shows at the end?
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round doubles it: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8.

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: The story should gain 2 pages every chapter. Fill the blank.
questions.explanation_after_check: Each round adds the blank. To go up by 2, the blank must be 2.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: True or false: this shows 5.
questions.explanation_after_check: total goes up by 1 each round, and the loop runs 4 times, so it ends at 4.

items.title: Counting scenes
items.intro: Loops: repeat a step: Repeat a scene chapter after chapter.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What numbers show?
questions.explanation_after_check: range(3) starts at 0 and stops before 3: 0, 1, 2.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: Which line does this: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4?
questions.explanation_after_check: range(n) starts at 0. range(a, b) starts at a and stops just before b.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What numbers show?
questions.explanation_after_check: range(1, 4) starts at 1 and stops before 4.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?

questions.label: Fill
questions.ask: Show chapters 1 to 5. Build the first line of the loop.
questions.explanation_after_check: range(1, 6) starts at 1 and stops before 6, so it counts 1 to 5.

notebook.label: How many lines show in total?

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows, in order?
questions.explanation_after_check: Both indented lines repeat together, in order, every round.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: The book club reads 4 chapters in a row. Which loop fits?
questions.explanation_after_check: range(4) repeats 4 times.

questions.label: Predict

questions.explanation_after_check: Each round adds 10: 40 → 50 → 60 → 70.

questions.label: Fix
questions.ask: This should show Read 3 times. Tap the line with the mistake.
questions.explanation_after_check: The first line of a loop must end with a colon. Fix: for chapter in range(3):

a.feedback: That leaves the mistake in place.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: How many lines show in total?
questions.explanation_after_check: 3 rounds with 2 lines each is 6 lines.

questions.label: Predict

items.title: Loud or soft

notebook.label: Which line does this: is less t…
Show Long book when pages is ov…

questions.label: Predict

questions.label: Predict

questions.label: Predict

questions.explanation_after_check: The loop counts 1, 2, 3. Only 2 matches, so Perform shows once.

questions.label: Predict
questions.ask: What shows?
questions.explanation_after_check: The loop counts 0 to 3. Only 1, 2, 3 are more than 0, so count is 3.
